scope.en: Rate the compiled arXiv version itself. The official conference PDF is an optional reference; differences between versions do not lower quality scores.
scope.zh: 评价 arXiv 编译版本本身。官方会议 PDF 仅作可选参考；版本差异不降低质量评分。

quick_rules.en: Read the compiled main paper and rate its six quality dimensions. Consult the official PDF only when helpful.
quick_rules.zh: 阅读编译版正文并评价六项质量；仅在有帮助时参考官方 PDF。

quick_rules.en: Use 1–5; use Uncertain if a dimension cannot be assessed. Technical Presentation alone allows N/A when no technical objects apply.
quick_rules.zh: 使用 1–5 分；无法评价时选“无法判断”。仅技术内容呈现可在无适用技术对象时选 N/A。

quick_rules.en: Judge Overall directly. Version differences are optional observations and never cap or reduce quality scores.
quick_rules.zh: 总体质量直接判断。版本差异为选填观察，不限制或降低质量评分。

quick_rules.en: Evidence, page references, version notes and private notes are optional.
quick_rules.zh: 证据、页码、版本说明和个人备注均为选填。

text.en: Rate the compiled version on its own merits. A newer conference version may change wording, structure, experiments or technical objects without making this version low quality. Publication headers, footers, copyright and pagination differences are not quality defects.
text.zh: 依据编译版本本身评分。较新的会议版可能修改措辞、结构、实验或技术对象，这不意味着本版本质量低。出版页眉页脚、版权与分页差异不属于质量缺陷。

text.en: A clearly written earlier version can receive high quality scores despite substantive changes in the official version. A missing object explicitly referenced by this compiled text is a document issue; an object added only in another version is not automatically a defect. Leave version observations blank if not assessed.
text.zh: 即使官方版有实质修订，表达清楚的早期版本仍可获得高质量分。编译正文明确引用但缺失的对象属于文档问题；仅在另一版本新增的对象不自动构成缺陷。未核查时可留空版本观察。

text.en: Review the full available compiled main-paper scope, including relevant technical objects. Judge communication and document usability, not research novelty or proof of scientific correctness. Uncertain is a valid completed response when assessment is blocked; it does not mean low quality.
text.zh: 检查编译版可用正文及相关技术对象。评价表达与文档可用性，不评价创新性或证明科学结论正确。因障碍无法评价时，“无法判断”是有效的已回答选项，不代表质量低。

text.en: Earlier alignment answers remain archived separately. No old score, including Visual Integrity, is copied into this protocol. Complete all six dimensions anew and confirm review of the compiled main paper.
text.zh: 此前对齐标注单独归档保留。包括视觉完整性在内的旧分数均不复制到本协议。请重新评价六项并确认已检查编译版正文。
